props.gloss_en: the mishna: and if there is no gentile with him, he places it on the donkey
a donkey and a deaf-mute, imbecile and minor: he places it on the donkey; he does not give it to the deaf-mute, imbecile or minor
what is the reason? these are persons; this is not a person
a deaf-mute and an imbecile: to the imbecile
an imbecile and a minor: to the imbecile
a deaf-mute and a minor, what? according to R' Eliezer you have no question
the teruma of a deaf-mute does not go out to non-sacred status, because he is a doubt
where you have the question is according to the Rabbis

the mishna: five may not separate teruma, and if they did their teruma is not teruma: a deaf-mute, an imbecile and a minor, one who separates from what is not his, and a gentile who separated a Jew's [produce] even with his permission
he gives it to the deaf-mute
he gives it to the minor
for the minor will come to [an age of] understanding
for the deaf-mute will come to be mistaken for a competent adult
R' Yitzchak: [where none of them is there] there was another [way], and the Sages did not want to reveal it
what is 'there was another'? he carries it [in stretches each] less than four cubits
why did the Sages not want to reveal it? because of 'the glory of God is to conceal a thing, and the glory of kings to search out a matter' (Prov 25:2)
and here, what glory of God is there? lest he come to carry four cubits in the public domain
R' Eliezer: on that day they heaped up the se'a
R' Yehoshua: on that day they levelled the se'a
R' Eliezer's parable: a basket full of cucumbers and gourds; a person puts mustard into it and it holds it
R' Yehoshua's parable: a trough full of honey; one puts pomegranates and nuts into it and it spews out
but he is driving a laden animal, and the Merciful One said 'you shall not do any labour'
Rav Adda bar Ahava: he places it on her while she is walking
when she walks he places it on her; when she stands he takes it off her
Rav Pappa: whatever in his own body incurs a sin-offering -- through his fellow, he is exempt but it is forbidden
Rav Pappa: whatever through his fellow is exempt but forbidden -- through his donkey is permitted ab initio
Rav Adda bar Ahava: if his bundle was resting on his shoulder, he runs under it until he reaches his house
specifically running; but [walking] slowly -- no
what is the reason? since he has no reminder, he will come to perform lifting and placing
[at his house] he throws it [down] in a backhanded manner
Rami bar Chama: one who drives his animal on Shabbat -- unwittingly, he is liable to a sin-offering
Rami bar Chama: wittingly, he is liable to stoning
Rava: the verse says 'you shall not do any labour, you ... and your animal' -- his animal is like himself: as he, unwittingly chatat and wittingly stoning, so too his animal
Rava: the whole Torah is juxtaposed to idolatry: as idolatry is where he does an act with his body, here too [one is liable] only when he does an act with his body
the mishna: one who desecrates Shabbat by a matter for whose inadvertence one is liable to a sin-offering and for whose wilfulness to stoning
unwittingly, he is not liable to a sin-offering (Rami bar Chama per Rav Zevid, 154a.1; the stam's unpacking of R' Yochanan, 154a.6)
and there is a matter for whose inadvertence one is not liable to a sin-offering and for whose wilfulness one is liable to stoning -- and what is it? driving
Rava, the brother of Rav Mari bar Rachel
and some say: the father of Rav Mari bar Rachel
Rav declared Rav Mari bar Rachel fit and appointed him over the pursei of Babylonia
R' Yochanan: one who drives his animal on Shabbat is exempt from everything
wittingly, too, he is not liable [to stoning]
for the lav, too, he is not liable [to lashes]
for it is a lav given as a warning for a court death penalty, and for any lav given as a warning for a court death penalty one is not lashed
and even for whoever says one is lashed: let the Merciful One write 'you shall not do any labour ... and your animal' -- why do I need 'you'? he is the one liable; through his animal he is not liable

בהמתו דומיא דידיה: ... במזיד חייב סקילה, אף בהמתו נמי

בלאו נמי לא מיחייב -- דהוה ליה לאו שניתן לאזהרת מיתת בית דין

the stam's first head of 'exempt from everything': not a sin-offering

objections.gloss_en: אמר מר: אין עמו גוי מניחו על החמור -- והלא מחמר, ורחמנא אמר לא תעשה כל מלאכה!

answered_by.gloss_en: מניחו עליה כשהיא מהלכת -- he places it on her while she walks (= p_manicho_kshehi_mehalechet)

objections.gloss_en: והא אי אפשר דלא קיימא להשתין מים ולהטיל גללים, ואיכא עקירה והנחה!

answered_by.gloss_en: כשהיא מהלכת מניחו עליה, כשהיא עומדת נוטלו הימנה (= p_notlo_kshehi_omedet)

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, אפילו חבירו נמי! -- if so, even [placing it on] his fellow too!

answered_by.gloss_en: כל שבגופו חייב חטאת בחבירו פטור אבל אסור, כל שחבירו פטור אבל אסור בחמורו מותר לכתחלה (= p_rp_bechavero_patur_aval_asur, p_rp_bachamoro_mutar)

objections.gloss_en: סוף סוף, כי מטי לביתיה אי אפשר דלא קאי פורתא, וקמעייל מרשות הרבים לרשות היחיד!
אמר רבא, שתי תשובות בדבר: חדא, הוקשה כל התורה כולה לעבודה זרה -- only for an act with his body (hekesh hk_kol_hatorah_laavoda_zara)
ועוד, תנן: המחלל את השבת בדבר שחייבין על שגגתו חטאת ועל זדונו סקילה -- מכלל דאיכא מידי דאין חייבין לא חטאת ולא סקילה, ומאי ניהו, לאו דמחמר?

answered_by.gloss_en: לא, תחומין ואליבא דרבי עקיבא, והבערה אליבא דרבי יוסי -- no: Shabbat limits per R' Akiva, and kindling per R' Yosei

objections.gloss_en: מתיב רבא: ... הא אין חייבין על שגגתו חטאת -- אין חייבין על זדונו סקילה!

answered_by.gloss_en: מי קתני 'הא אין חייבין'? הכי קאמר: ... ויש דבר שאין חייבין על שגגתו חטאת וחייבין על זדונו סקילה -- מחמר (= p_yesh_davar_chayav_skila_belo_chatat)

objections.gloss_en: ללישנא בתרא, קשיא הא דרב אכשריה לרב מרי בר רחל ומנייה בפורסי דבבל

answered_by.gloss_en: דילמא תרי מרי בר רחל הוו -- perhaps there were two Mari bar Rachels
